text:
claire.design: Quick microcopy + a11y pulse on the 'Create eval' empty state in the Eval Suites view. Current CTA reads 'Create one' and the helper says 'Compare model outputs with tests.' a11y flagged the CTA as ambiguous when read alone.

dylan.pm: yea product wants the CTA to be explicit about what the action does. We get tickets where PMs click and expect something else.

ravi.eng: implementation note: the button opens the 'New Eval' modal. We can add aria-describedby to a hidden paragraph for screen readers if the visual text needs to be short.

mai.a11y: link/button text should be meaningful out of context. If it reads 'Create one' that doesn't help keyboard users who might tab into it. Options: 'Create eval', 'Create eval suite', 'Start new eval' — I prefer 'Create eval' for brevity and clarity. Also suggest adding an aria-describedby that points to a short paragraph describing what an eval does.

claire.design: microcopy options I mocked:
- Short: 'Create eval' (primary)
- Slightly more explicit: 'Create eval suite'
- Friendly: 'Start comparing models'
Visually I like 'Create eval' and then a one-line helper: 'Run tests to compare model outputs and surface regressions.' That helper will be in the DOM with id=eval-empty-desc and referenced by aria-describedby on the CTA.

dylan.pm: product ok with 'Create eval' + helper. Also request we include a tiny example test link in the helper: 'Try a sample test' linking to a template. That might improve discoverability.

ravi.eng: accessibility caveat: aria-describedby must reference an element that is in the DOM and should be visible or offscreen — not inside a collapsed region. Also ensure the empty state region has role="region" and an accessible name so screen reader users can find it.

mai.a11y: add to checklist: meaningful CTA text, aria-describedby present, region announced with aria-label (e.g., 'Eval suites empty state'), helper text concise (<120 chars), contrast checks on CTA, and keyboard focus goes to modal when CTA is activated.

ops-bot: incident 2026-03-01T11:22:03Z: no active eval runs in prod.

claire.design: updated plan: Visual CTA: 'Create eval' Helper (id=eval-empty-desc): 'Run tests to compare model outputs and detect regressions. Try a sample test.' Empty state container: role="region" aria-label="Eval suites empty state". I'll update the Figma and add tokens to the copy file.

dylan.pm: small follow-up: track click-through on 'Try a sample test' and the create CTA. If we see low engagement, consider replacing helper with a short walkthrough.

ravi.eng: I'll wire up aria-describedby and ensure focus handling for the modal. Also will truncate long suite names in the table but expose full name in aria-label for rows.

mai.a11y: last note: when the modal opens, announce via role="dialog" and set focus to the first input. Test with VoiceOver and NVDA.

claire.design: thanks! i'll push the figma update and post the copy tokens. Tagging @dylan.pm for final product review once in Figma. :sparkles:
